question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Annoy
solution:
The correct answer is "**Irritate**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meanings of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• "**Annoy" means to irritate or bother someone. **(चिढ़ाना)

 
 
• Example: My brother used to annoy me a lot.
 
 
 
• Synonym of annoy is** irritate, which means to provoke or annoy someone**.(कुढ़ाना)
 
 
• Example: The constant buzzing of the mosquito annoyed me all night.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Testify) means to give evidence in court or to bear witness.(गवाही देना)
 
• Option 3 (Suppress) means to prevent something from being expressed or revealed.(दबाना)
 
• Option 4 (Delight) means to please or give pleasure to someone.(आनंद)
